blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World-action models adapt pretrained video generators, and vision-language-action models build on pretrained vision-language backbones; both tie policy architecture and inference cost to large transformers designed for generation rather than control. It remains unclear how much these generation-oriented choices affect control. In this work, we introduce Latent Action JEPA (La-JEPA), a compact world-action model whose policy transformer is trained from scratch in the feature space of a pretrained V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. Following Fast-WAM, La-JEPA learns to predict future features jointly with actions during training and generates only actions at inference. Among policies without embodied pretraining, La-JEPA achieves state-of-the-art performance in clean and randomized RoboTwin 2.0 scenes and on LIBERO-Plus with correct instructions, while using far fewer parameters than the strongest competing policies. It runs substantially faster than Fast-WAM at comparable performance and outperforms the closest JEPA-based methods, LeapBot-WA and JEPA-WAM, on LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0 without their pretrained policy backbones. On four real-robot tasks, its average success is comparable to pi0.5 and above non-embodied-pretrained baselines. Through a design study of the choices behind La-JEPA, we show that JEPA features outperform video VAE latents, most clearly out of distribution, and that training-time future prediction choices significantly impact the policy even when future prediction is skipped at inference. We correct the LIBERO-Plus instructions, as the officially released evaluator corrupts them for most variants, and re-evaluate several strong open baselines. Without a generative pretrained policy backbone, La-JEPA is better and faster than far larger policies, suggesting that robot foundation models may benefit from architectures designed for control rather than inherited from generation.
blocks.zh: 世界行动模型适应预先训练的视频发电机,视觉语言行动模型建立在预先训练的视觉语言主干线上;将政策架构和推论成本与设计用于生成而不是控制的大型变压器挂钩. 仍然不清楚这些面向一代的选择对控制的影响有多大。 在这项工作中,我们介绍了Latent Action JEPA(La-JEPA),这是一个紧凑的世界行动模式,其政策变迁器从零开始在经过预先培训的V-JEPA 2.1编码器的特性空间中培训。 在快速WAM之后,La-JEPA学会了在培训期间与行动共同预测未来特征,只产生推论性的行动. 在没有包含预训内容的政策中,La-JEPA在干净和随机的RoboTwin 2.0场景和LIBERO-Plus上以正确的指示实现了最先进的性能,同时使用的参数远远少于最强的竞争政策. 其运行速度大大快于快速WAM的可比性能,并且超过了以JEPA为基础的最接近方法,即LeapBot-WA和JEPA-WAM,在LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin 2.0上运行,而没有经过事先培训的政策骨干。 在四项实际机器人任务上,平均成功率可与0.5比0.5和高于非初步训练的基线相比。 通过对La-JEPA背后的选择进行设计研究,我们显示,JEPA的性能超过了VAE的潜质,最明显地是没有分布,培训时间的未来预测选择即使在未来预测被推论忽略,也会对政策产生重大影响。 我们纠正了LIBERO-Plus指令,因为官方发布的评估者将它们腐蚀到大多数变种,并重新评价了几个强大的开放基线. 没有先天性的政策骨干,La-JEPA比远大的政策更好,更快,说明机器人基础模型可能从为控制而设计的架构中受益,而不是代代相传.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: World-action models increasingly adapt pretrained video-generation transformers to robot control, inheriting useful visual and temporal priors along with the representation space, tokenization, and architecture of a model built for video synthesis ( Yuan et al., 2026b ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) . Vision-language-action policies take a similar route using language-generation transformers aligned with visual inputs ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2024 ; Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ) . The success of these two types of architectures raises two practical questions: must robot policies necessarily inherit the architecture of a generative backbone to be competitive, and can a compact world-action transformer trained from scratch actually reach the performance of these policies?
blocks.zh: 世界动作模型越来越多地将经过预先训练的视频生成变压器用于机器人控制,继承了有用的视觉和时间前科,以及用于视频合成的模型的表示空间,标语化和架构(袁等人,2026b;马等人,2026;金等人,2026). 视觉语言动作政策采用类似的路线,使用与视觉输入一致的语言生成变压器(Kim等人,2024年;Black等人,2024年;物理智能等人,2025年). 这两类建筑的成功提出了两个实际问题:机器人政策是否必须继承基因骨干结构才能具有竞争力,从零开始训练的紧凑的世界行动变压器能否真正达到这些政策的绩效?

blocks.en: Most world-action models (WAMs) are VAE-based because they build on pretrained video generators, yet better-suited latent spaces are available. Video VAEs retain accurate information but spend much of their capacity on pixel-level fidelity that control does not require. JEPA representations, in contrast, are developed and evaluated for downstream tasks such as video understanding, depth estimation, and segmentation, which are closer to the needs of embodied agents ( Assran et al., 2025 ; Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) . Previous work aligns VLMs or video-generation models to the JEPA space ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) or learns a JEPA-style latent space jointly with the policy ( Vujinovic & Kovacevic, 2025 ) ; to our knowledge, no prior work trains a compact world-action policy from scratch in a pretrained JEPA feature space.
blocks.zh: 大多数世界行动模型(WAMS)基于VAE,因为它们建立在经过预先训练的视频生成器上,然而却有更适合的潜在空间. 视频 VAEs保留了准确的信息,但将其大部分能力用于控制不需要的像素级忠诚. 相比之下,JEPA的表述是针对下游任务,如视频理解、深度估计和分解,这些任务更接近于体现物剂的需要(Asran等人,2025年;Mur-Labadia等人,2026年)。 先前的作品将VLM或视频生成模型与JEPA空间(Lin等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026年)相配合,或与政策共同学习JEPA风格的潜在空间(Vujnovic & Kovacevic, 2025年);据我们所知,任何前作品都不会在经过预先培训的JEPA特征空间中从头开始训练紧凑的世界行动政策。

blocks.en: We introduce Latent Action JEPA (La-JEPA) , a world-action model that learns future-feature prediction and action generation directly in the dense spatial and temporal feature space of a pretrained V-JEPA 2.1 video encoder ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) . Its World DiT and Action DiT are initialized from scratch, allowing their architecture and capacity to be chosen independently of the visual encoder. Following Fast-WAM and Faster-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026b ; Ma et al., 2026 ) , actions attend to observed context but not to future tokens, so predictive supervision can shape the policy during training without the cost of generating the future at inference time.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了Latent Action JEPA(La-JEPA),这是一个世界行动模型,在经过预先训练的V-JEPA 2.1视频编码器(Mur-Labadia等人,2026年)的密集空间和时间特征空间直接学习未来地貌预测和行动生成。 其World DiT和Action DiT从零开始初始化,使得它们的架构和能力可以独立于视觉编码器进行选择. 继Fast-WAM和Secret-WAM(袁等人,2026b;马等人,2026)之后,各项行动都关注观察到的背景,而不是未来的征兆,因此预测性监督可以在培训期间制定政策,而无需在推断时间创造未来。

blocks.en: Among policies without embodied pretraining, La-JEPA achieves the strongest clean and randomized RoboTwin 2.0 results and the strongest LIBERO-Plus results with corrected instructions (Section 5.2 ), with about four times fewer deployed parameters than the next-best policies, while running up to 5 × \times faster than Fast-WAM, whose design we follow (Figure 1 , Tables 1 and 2 ). With the released instructions, it is second only to NowWAM, which is insensitive to the corrupted text (Table 14 ). It also outperforms the closest JEPA-based methods, LeapBot-WA and JEPA-WAM, on LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0 (Table 3 ). On real-robot tasks ranging from cube placement to contact-rich pushing and long-horizon manipulation, La-JEPA trained from scratch on the target demonstrations achieves the highest average success among the compared policies, comparable to the embodied-pretrained π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} (Table 5 ). Together, these results demonstrate leading benchmark performance, efficient inference, and competitive physical manipulation without requiring a generative backbone.
blocks.zh: 在没有体现预先训练的政策中,La-JEPA取得了最强的清洁和随机化RoboTwin 2.0结果和最强的LIBERO-Plus结果,其部署的参数比次佳政策大约少四倍,同时运行速度比我们所遵循的Fast-WAM快(图1,表1和表2)。 与发布的指令相比,它仅次于NowWAM,后者对腐败的文本不敏感(表14). 它还在LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin 2.0(表3)上超过了以JEPA为基础的最接近的方法LeapBot-WA和JEPA-WAM。 在实际机器人任务方面,从立方体放置到接触丰富的推力和长视距操纵,从头到尾接受目标示范培训的La-JEPA在比较政策中取得了最高的平均成功,可与内含的预先训练的0.5\pi=0.5}相当(表5)。 这些结果加在一起表明主要的基准业绩、有效推论和竞争性物理操纵,而不需要基因骨干。

blocks.en: To understand which design choices enable this performance, we study the impact of the representation space, different targets for predictive supervision, and robustness mechanisms. We adopt a compact first approach, making the architecture viable even for a policy with 0.1B trainable parameters, before increasing policy capacity. Comparisons of JEPA features and VAE latents span both benchmarks and multiple model configurations, showing that JEPA features generally outperform VAE latents, with the clearest gains for out of distribution evaluations (Section 4.1 , Appendix A.1 ). Action-only controls separately confirm the benefit of WAM-style future prediction, and studies of temporal encoding, dropout, augmentation, and encoder adaptation complete the recipe. These analyses support the central contribution: a compact, effective world-action policy, together with evidence to guide its design. As a secondary contribution, we show that the released LIBERO-Plus evaluator appends perturbation parameters to most instructions, so that most variants apply two perturbations at once. This corruption affects policies to very different degrees, from no change to 19 points, and obscures the robustness study that the benchmark is designed for; we therefore re-evaluate the openly available baselines with corrected instructions under a single “clean” protocol that isolates each perturbation as intended (Section 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: 为了了解哪些设计选择能促进这种表现,我们研究了代表空间的影响,预测监督的不同目标,以及稳健性机制。 我们采取了紧凑的第一办法,在提高政策能力之前,甚至使具有0.1B可训练参数的政策结构可行。 对联合环保局特征和VAE潜在值的比较既涉及基准,也涉及多个模型配置,表明联合环保局的特征一般优于VAE潜在值,最明显的收益来自分配评价(第4.1节,附录A.1)。 只行动控制分别证实了WAM式未来预测的好处,对时间编码、退出、增强和编码器适应的研究完成了配方。 这些分析支持了中心贡献:一项紧凑、有效的世界行动政策,以及指导其设计的证据。 作为次要贡献,我们显示,所发布的LIBERO-Plus评价员附加扰动参数是大多数指令的,因此大多数变体同时适用两种扰动. 这种腐败对政策的影响程度非常不同,从没有变化到19点,并模糊了基准所设计的稳健性研究;因此,我们重新评价公开的基线,并根据单一的“干净”协议作出纠正指示,按原意隔离每次扰动(第5.2节)。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies extend pretrained vision-language models with action outputs, predicting discretized action tokens ( Kim et al., 2024 ) or attaching a flow-matching action expert ( Black et al., 2024 ) , and broaden their training data to generalize further ( Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2026a ) . All inherit the size and inference cost of a multi-billion-parameter vision-language backbone.
blocks.zh: 愿景语言行动(VLA)政策扩展了预先训练的愿景语言模式,并附有行动产出,预测了盘状动作符号(Kim等人,2024年)或附上了流动匹配动作专家(Black等人,2024年),并扩展了培训数据以进一步概括(物理情报等人,2025年;袁等人,2026年a年)。 都继承了数十亿参数的视觉语言主干线的大小和推论成本.

blocks.en: World-action models (WAMs) instead build on pretrained video or image generators whose representations drive action generation ( Kim et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) , reaching the strongest previously reported LIBERO-Plus results among policies without embodied pretraining. Because generating future frames slows inference, recent WAMs predict the future only during training ( Yuan et al., 2026b ) and reduce the action expert to a single layer that reads keys and values cached from all layers of the video backbone ( Ma et al., 2026 ) . All retain the generator backbone in the deployed policy.
blocks.zh: 世界行动模型(WAMs)则建立在预先训练过的视频或图像生成器上,其表达力驱动动作生成(Kim等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年),在未包含预先训练内容的各项政策中达到以往报告的最强LIBERO-Plus结果. 由于生成未来帧会延缓推断,最近的WAM只在训练期间预测未来(Yuan等人,2026年b),并将动作专家缩小为读取从视频主干线各层缓存的密钥和值的单层(Ma等人,2026年). 在部署的政策中,所有发电机都保留了主干。

blocks.en: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn representations by predicting the embeddings of masked inputs rather than reconstructing pixels ( Assran et al., 2023 ) . V-JEPA extends this objective to video ( Bardes et al., 2024 ) , V-JEPA 2 scales it ( Assran et al., 2025 ) , and V-JEPA 2.1 improves the dense features of V-JEPA 2 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) , which makes it especially well suited to robotic policies. JEPA representations have since been used in robot policies: ACT-JEPA learns a JEPA-style latent space jointly with the policy ( Vujinovic & Kovacevic, 2025 ) , VLA-JEPA and JEPA-VLA bring V-JEPA targets or features into vision-language-action models ( Sun et al., 2026 ; Miao et al., 2026 ) , and JEPA-WAM and LeapBot-WA build world-action models on V-JEPA features ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . These two world-action models are the closest to La-JEPA, but both initialize their predictors from pretrained vision-language or video generation models.
blocks.zh: 联合嵌入式预测架构(JEPAs)通过预测蒙面输入的嵌入而不是重建像素(Assran等人,2023年)来学习表示法. V-JEPA将这一目标推广到视频(Bardes等人,2024年),V-JEPA 2 尺度(Asran等人,2025年),V-JEPA 2.1改进了V-JEPA 2的密集特征(Mur-Labadia等人,2026年),这使得它特别适合机器人政策. 从那时起,JEPA的表述被用于机器人政策:ACT-JEPA与政策(Vujnovic & Kovacevic, 2025年)一起学习了JEPA风格的潜在空间,VLA-JEPA和JEPA-VLA将V-JEPA的目标或特征纳入视觉-语言行动模型(Sun等人,2026年;Miao等人,2026年),JEPA-WAM和LeapBot-WA就V-JEPA特征构建了世界行动模型(Lin等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026年)。 这两种世界动作模型最接近La-JEPA,但两者都从预先训练的视觉语言或视频生成模型中初始化其预测器.

blocks.en: Policies that are competitive without inheriting either a VLM or video backbone are scarce. While Diffusion Policy ( Chi et al., 2023 ) , DP3 ( Ze et al., 2024 ) and ACT ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) exist, their performance is rarely close to VLAs and World Models. MINT predicts coarse-to-fine action tokens with a separately trained action tokenizer ( Huang et al., 2026 ) and reaches much better success rates, but remains below the strongest WAMs and VLAs. La-JEPA fits in this category as it trains its policy DiTs from scratch while adding WAM-style future prediction in a pretrained JEPA feature space.
blocks.zh: 没有继承VLM或视频主干线的竞争性政策很少。 虽然传播政策(Chi等人,2023年),DP3(Ze等人,2024年)和ACT(Zhao等人,2023年)存在,但其表现很少接近VLA和世界模型. MINT预测粗到细的动作符,并配有经过单独训练的动作指示器(Huang等人,2026年),并取得了更好的成功率,但仍低于最强的WAM和VLA. La-JEPA符合这一类别,因为它从零开始培训其政策DiTs,同时在经过预先培训的JEPA特征空间中加入WAM式的未来预测.

blocks.en: 3.1 Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.1 建筑

blocks.en: Figure 2: La-JEPA. Left: general architecture. Right: context and future encoding with V-JEPA 2.1.
blocks.zh: 图2:La-JEPA。 左:一般建筑. 右:背景与未来与V-JEPA的编码 2.1.

blocks.en: The pretrained V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-L encoder ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) processes each camera independently, producing observation features z ctx z_{\mathrm{ctx}} from the most recent frames, and future targets z fut z_{\mathrm{fut}} representing the 32 frames ahead. We normalize and spatially reduce these feature grids before projecting them into the World DiT’s embedding space. They are the model’s only visual input and prediction target, so the model gets no separate RGB pathway. Future predictions are matched to targets directly in V-JEPA space and require no pixel reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 预先训练的V-JEPA 2.1 VIT-L编码器(Mur-Labadia等人,2026年)独立处理每台相机,从最近的帧中产生观测特征z ctx z_{\mathrm{ctx}},未来的目标z fut z_{\mathrm{fut}})代表前面的32帧. 我们把这些特征网格固定下来, 它们是模型唯一的视觉输入和预测目标,因此模型没有单独的RGB路径. 未来的预测直接与V-JEPA空间中的目标匹配,不需要像素重建.

blocks.en: A frozen FLAN-T5-large encoder ( Chung et al., 2022 ) embeds the instruction ℓ \ell , and learned projections map proprioception s t s_{t} to additional tokens; together they form the conditioning sequence z cond z_{\mathrm{cond}} , which both DiTs read through cross-attention.
blocks.zh: 一个冷冻的FLAN-T5大型编码器(Chung等人,2022年)将指令l\ell嵌入,并学习到的预测地图protrioception s t s_{t}附加的符号;它们共同组成了调节序列z cond z_{\mathrm{cond}}),两个DiTs通过交叉读取.

blocks.en: The model is made of two diffusion transformers (DiTs) ( Peebles & Xie, 2022 ) : a World DiT over observation and future-feature tokens and an Action DiT over the action chunk. Both are initialized from scratch with separate attention projections and feed-forward layers, so pretrained knowledge enters only through the visual and language encoders. Rotary visual positional encodings ( Su et al., 2021 ) preserve spatial and temporal information. The two DiTs interact at every layer, where action queries read the World DiT’s observation keys and values alongside its own. The attention mask keeps future information out of the action pathway: observation tokens attend only to observations, future tokens to observations and futures, and action tokens to observations and actions. Actions therefore never access future features directly, yet predictive supervision still shapes the observation representations they read through the shared World DiT parameters during training.
blocks.zh: 该模型由两台扩散变压器(DiTs)(Peebles & Xie, 2022年)制成:一个世界DiT 凌驾于观测和未来的地标,一个动作DiT 凌驾于动作块之上. 两者都是从零开始初始化的,有单独的关注预测和向导层,因此预先训练的知识只能通过视觉和语言编码器进入. 扶轮视位编码(Su等人,2021年)保存时空信息. 两个DiT在每一层相互作用,其中动作查询会同时读取世界DiT的观测键和值。 注意面罩使未来信息远离动作路径:观察符只注意观察,观察未来和将来的标志,观察和行动的行动标志. 因此,行动永远不能直接获得未来的特征,然而,预测性监督仍然决定了他们在培训期间通过共享的世界数字参数读取的观察表述。

blocks.en: 3.2 Training and Inference
blocks.zh: 3.2 培训和推断

blocks.en: We train both DiTs with future and action-space flow matching ( Lipman et al., 2022 ) . blocks.en: We test the design choices behind Section 5 with the small (S) policy unless stated otherwise. We ask, in turn, whether to predict future features, in which feature space, how to encode motion (Section 4.1 ), and then how to make the policy robust to observation changes (Section 4.2 ). The studies use LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and clean-trained RoboTwin 2.0 ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Fei et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) ; in-distribution (IID) evaluation refers to LIBERO or clean RoboTwin scenes, and out-of-distribution (OOD) evaluation to LIBERO-Plus or randomized scenes. Figure 3 reports each choice’s gain in success in percentage points (hereafter, points), grouped into blocks A to F. Each block has its own reference recipe, so comparisons hold within a block; Table 6 lists baselines and evaluation budgets, and Appendix A documents the protocols.
blocks.zh: 我们用小(S)政策来测试第5节背后的设计选择,除非另有说明。 反过来,我们又问,是否要预测未来的特征,即哪个特征空间,如何编码运动(第4.1节),然后如何使政策对观察变化有力(第4.2节)。 研究采用LIBERO,LIBERO-Plus,以及清洁训练的RoboTwin 2.0(刘等人,2023年;Fei等人,2025年;Chen等人,2025年);内分配评价(IID)是指LIBERO或清洁的RoboTwin场景,外分配评价(OOD)是指LIBERO-Plus或随机场景. 图3按百分点(以下简称百分点)报告每个选择的成功收益,分为A至F组。 每个组都有自己的参考食谱,因此比较在一个组内进行; 表6列出了基线和评价预算,附录A记录了协议。

blocks.en: 4.1 Prediction Target and Feature Space
blocks.zh: 4.1 预测目标和地貌空间

blocks.en: We first test whether predicting future features benefits the policy, comparing joint action and future-feature prediction with action-only training (Figure 3 A). Future prediction raises RoboTwin success by 7.0 points in clean and 3.7 in randomized scenes. On LIBERO-Plus, it improves success for each of three training seeds, by 2.1 points on average, with every paired comparison significant ( p < 0.01 p<0.01 , McNemar; Appendix A.1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先测试预测未来特征是否有利于政策,将联合行动和未来特质预测与只行动培训进行比较(图3 A)。 未来预测将RoboTwin成功提升7.0分的清场和3.7分的随机场景. 在LIBERO-Plus上,它使三颗训练种子中的每一颗都提高了成功率,平均得分为2.1分,每对比较都显著(p < 0.01 p < 0.01, McNemar;附录A.1)。

blocks.en: We next ask in which space prediction should be learned, comparing frozen V-JEPA 2.1 features with latents of the VAE of Wan2.2 ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ) , the video model underlying Fast-WAM, Faster-WAM, and LeapBot-WA (Figure 3 B). Each policy learns action and future-feature prediction with the normalization and projections suited to its representation, so the comparison evaluates each representation together with its interface to the policy. V-JEPA improves success in all four evaluations of this pair: by 15.9 points in clean and 16.0 in randomized RoboTwin scenes, and by 6.0 on LIBERO-Plus and 2.0 on LIBERO. In randomized scenes, the Wan2.2 policy collapses and succeeds in only 1.0% of episodes, close to the video-generator WAMs in Table 2 . In two additional RoboTwin comparisons (Appendix A.1 ), clean success is comparable in one and favors Wan2.2 in the other, whereas randomized success, reported for the second, again strongly favors V-JEPA. These results echo those of LDA-1B, which similarly reports a large gain from replacing VAE latents with DINO features ( Lyu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们接下来问,应当学习哪些空间预测,将冻结的V-JEPA 2.1特性与Wan2.2的VAE(Team Wan等人,2025年),Fast-WAM的视频模型,S更快的WAM和LeapBot-WA(图3 B)的潜伏物进行比较。 每项政策都学习行动和未来特点的预测以及适合其代表性的正常化和预测,因此比较评估了每项代表性及其与政策的联系。 V-JEPA改进了这对全部4个评价的成功:15.9分的清场和16.0分的随机RoboTwin场景,6.0分的LiBERO-Plus和2.0分的LiBERO. 在随机化场景中,Wan2.2政策崩溃,只成功1.0%的剧集,接近表2中的视频生成器WAM. 在另外两项RoboTwin比较(附录A.1)中,干净的成功在其中具有可比性,而在另一方面则有利于Wan2.2,而在第二方面则报告随机的成功,再次强烈支持V-JEPA。 这些结果与LDA-1B的结果相呼应,LDA-1B同样报告说,用DINO特性取代VAE潜伏物有很大收益(Lyu等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Unlike LDA-1B’s DINO, which only encodes images, V-JEPA 2.1 can process videos, which raises the question of how the observations and future targets should be encoded. We tested three configurations. Static encodings treat every frame as an image: the observation is the current frame, and eight future targets, spaced four frames apart up to 32 frames ahead, are encoded separately. Tube encoding instead processes two-frame clips aligned with the encoder’s tubelets, ending at the current frame for the observation and at each target frame for the futures; the observation clip thus gives the policy a motion cue without access to future observations. Tube-motion keeps the tube observation but jointly encodes the 16 future frames, spaced two frames apart, so each of the eight future feature grids attends over the whole predicted horizon (Figure 2 , right). Relative to static encoding on RoboTwin (Figure 3 C), tube encoding raises clean success by 1.1 points and randomized success by 3.6, and tube-motion preserves the randomized gain ( + 3.7 +3.7 ) while raising the clean gain to 3.4; the final recipe therefore uses tube-motion.
blocks.zh: 与LDA-1B的DINO(只编码图像)不同,V-JEPA 2.1可以处理视频,这提出了观测和将来的目标应该如何编码的问题. 我们测试了三种配置。 静态编码将每个帧作为图像处理:观测是当前帧,八个未来目标,间隔四个帧,最高前方32帧,分别编码. 管道编码处理与编码器的管片一致的两帧剪辑,以当前观察框架和每个未来目标框结束;因此,观察剪辑给政策一个运动提示,而不能接触未来的观察。 管-运动保持管的观测,但共同编码了16个未来的帧,将两个帧分隔开来,因此未来8个特征网格中的每个都覆盖整个预测的视野(图2,右). 相对于在RoboTwin(图3 C)上的静态编码,管编码以1.1分提升干净成功,以3.6分提升随机成功,管动保留随机收益(+3.7+3.7),同时将清洁收益提升到3.4;因此最终配方使用管动.

blocks.en: Before entering the World DiT, the encoded feature grids are reduced spatially, either by averaging neighboring features (mean pooling) or by concatenating them into one token (patch grouping). We initially used mean pooling for its simplicity, since it can be applied once to the precomputed features. On RoboTwin, patch grouping improved randomized success, so the final RoboTwin recipe uses it; LIBERO did not benefit from it (89.35% against 94.05% with mean pooling), so we kept mean pooling there (Appendix A.1 ).
blocks.zh: 在进入World DiT之前,编码的特征网格在空间上有所缩小,或者通过平均邻域特征(平均集合),或者通过将邻域特征调和成一个符号(patch group). 我们最初使用"集合"来简化它,因为它可以一次应用到预先计算过的特性. 在RoboTwin上,补丁分组提高了随机化的成功率,因此最终的RoboTwin配方使用了它;LIBERO并没有从中获利(89.35%对94.05%为平均集合),因此我们一直保持了在那里的"平均集合"(Appendix A.1 ).

blocks.en: 4.2 Robustness and Encoder Adaptation
blocks.zh: 4.2 强性和编码器适应

blocks.en: To reduce reliance on any single view, we drop eligible cameras during training, always retaining at least one view and removing the dropped cameras’ future targets from the loss (Figure 3 D). This is the condition dropout used to train classifier-free guidance ( Ho & Salimans, 2022 ) , although we sample without guidance. Dropping only the wrist cameras raises randomized RoboTwin success by 7.1 points, while clean success remains essentially unchanged. LIBERO benefits from this too: by allowing either camera to be dropped, we raise LIBERO-Plus success by 10.2 points, with large gains under camera-viewpoint and sensor-noise perturbations (Table 8 ), while in-distribution success slightly improves.
blocks.zh: 为了减少对任何单一视图的依赖,我们在训练期间放下合格的摄像头,始终保留至少一个视图,并且从损失中移除掉的摄像头的未来目标(图3 D). 校对:Soup 只放下手腕相机,将随机化的RoboTwin成功提升了7.1分,而干净的成功基本上保持不变. LIBERO也从中得益:通过允许任何一台相机投放,我们把LIBERO-Plus的成功提升了10.2点,在相机-视点和传感器-噪音扰动(表8)下取得了巨大收益,而分配成功略有改善.

blocks.en: Dropping the proprioceptive conditioning with probability 0.1 during training, with the configuration otherwise unchanged, raises RoboTwin success by 3.8 points in clean and 4.2 in randomized scenes (Figure 3 E). The final recipe therefore uses both camera and proprioception dropout.
blocks.zh: 在训练中以概率0.1放弃自控调节,配置否则不变,使RoboTwin成功在清洁中提升3.8分,在随机场景中提升4.2分(图3 E). 因此,最后的食谱既使用摄像头,也使用自行消毒。

blocks.en: Finally, we combine image augmentation of the observations with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) adaptation of the observation encoder; future targets are still computed from unmodified frames by the original encoder for training efficiency purposes (Appendix B ). Relative to a plain LIBERO policy (Figure 3 F), LoRA alone adds 1.4 points on LIBERO-Plus, augmentation alone 5.8, and both together 7.2, while in-distribution success remains unchanged. The combined recipe also improves RoboTwin, raising clean success by 5.7 points and randomized success by 16.0 (Appendix A.2 ).
blocks.zh: 最后,我们将观测图的图像增强与观测编码器的LORA(Hu等人,2021年)的调整结合起来;为了培训效率的目的,未来的目标仍由原始编码器(Appendix B.)从未修改的框架计算。 相对于普通的LIBERO政策(图3 F),仅LORA在LIBERO-Plus上就增加了1.4分,单是增强5.8分,两者加在一起为7.2分,而分配成功则保持不变. 综合配方还改进了RoboTwin,以5.7分提高了干净的成功率,以16.0分(附录A.2.

blocks.en: 4.3 Final Recipe
blocks.zh: 4.3 最后食谱

blocks.en: These studies define the final recipe: joint action and future prediction in V-JEPA 2.1 tube-motion features, camera and proprioception dropout, and image augmentation with encoder LoRA. We train it at three sizes, S, B, and L (Table 9 ), which correspond to 0.10, 0.34, and 1.14 B trainable parameters respectively. Appendix B documents the remaining benchmark-specific settings.
blocks.zh: 这些研究界定了最后的配方:在V-JEPA 2.1中联合行动和未来预测的管动特性、相机和自发性断电以及用编码器LORA增强图像。 我们按S、B和L三种尺寸(表9)进行训练,分别对应0.10、0.34和1.14B的可训练参数。 附 录 B 记录其余的特定基准设置。

blocks.zh: 5 实验结果.

blocks.zh: 5.1 业绩和概况

blocks.en: Both benchmarks test generalization beyond the training distribution. On RoboTwin, policies are trained on clean demonstrations only and evaluated in both clean scenes and randomized scenes, which add clutter, distractor objects, and new textures. On LIBERO, policies are trained on the four standard suites and evaluated both on them and on LIBERO-Plus, which perturbs them along seven axes such as camera viewpoint, lighting, and sensor noise. On RoboTwin, all three La-JEPA sizes outperform every baseline in both regimes, with the largest margin in randomized scenes (Table 2 ). On LIBERO-Plus, success increases with size. With the released instructions, L exceeds every baseline except NowWAM ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , which deploys four times more parameters; with corrected instructions (Section 5.2 ), all three sizes exceed or match every re-evaluated baseline, and L leads NowWAM by 1.8 points. On LIBERO, where most methods are close to saturation, all three sizes come within 0.6 points of the best baseline.
blocks.zh: 这两项基准都考验了培训分配之外的通用性。 在RoboTwin上,政策只接受清洁示威的培训,并在清洁场景和随机场景中进行评价,这些场景增加了杂乱无章的,分散注意力的物体,以及新的纹理. 在LIBERO上,对四个标准套房的政策进行了培训,并对这些套房和LIBERO-Plus进行了评估,这些套房沿摄像头、照明和传感器噪音等七个轴线对套房进行扰动。 在RoboTwin上,所有三个La-JEPA的大小都超过了两个制度中的每个基线,随机场景的比值最大(表2)。 在LIBERO-Plus上,成功随大小而增加. 发布指令后,L超过了除NowWAM(Wang等人,2026年)外的每一个基线,它部署的参数是4倍;经过更正指令(第5.2节),所有三个尺寸都超过或匹配每个重新评价的基线,L带领NowWAM达到1.8分. 在大多数方法接近饱和度的LIBERO上,所有三个尺寸都位于最佳基线的0.6点之内.

blocks.en: RoboTwin success, in contrast, does not monotonically increase with size. We did not vary the relative size of the Action DiT, which matches the World DiT at every size, and we hypothesize that a larger action expert more easily overfits the action distribution, which is far simpler than the distribution of future features, even when regularized by the world loss. Faster-WAM, whose single-layer action expert generalizes well on LIBERO-Plus ( Ma et al., 2026 ) , is consistent with this hypothesis.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,RoboTwin的成功并不单调地随着体积的增加而增加. 我们并没有改变动作DiT的相对大小,它与世界DiT的大小相匹配,我们假设一个更大的动作专家更容易比动作分配更适合,这远比未来特性的分布简单,即使被世界损失合法化. 更快的WAM,其单层动作专家对LIBERO-Plus(马等人,2026年)的概括性很好,符合这个假设.

blocks.en: Figure 4 adds embodied-pretrained policies for reference. La-JEPA B’s mean over the two regimes exceeds that of all but four of them, OLA-Sem, GigaBrain-0.7 ( GigaBrain Team et al., 2026 ) , Qwen-RobotManip, and 4D-WAM ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , which all reach higher randomized but lower clean success, as expected when robot pretraining data already covers part of the randomized variation.
blocks.zh: 图4增加了经过预先培训的政策供参考。 拉-杰伊帕 B对这两个制度的恶性超过了除4个制度以外的所有制度,LALA-Sem,GigaBrain-0.7(GigaBrain Team等人,2026年),Quen-RobotManip,以及4D-WAM(Yang等人,2026年),它们都达到了更高的随机性但更低的清洁性成功,当机器人预训数据已经覆盖了部分随机性变异时,就预期到了.

blocks.en: 5.2 Instruction Leakage in LIBERO-Plus
blocks.zh: 5.2 LIBERO-Plus指令泄漏

blocks.en: Table 4: Instruction received for two LIBERO-Plus variants. Bold: deviations from the training instruction.
blocks.zh: 表4:关于两个LIBERO-Plus变体的指令。 粗体:偏离训练指示.

blocks.en: The released LIBERO-Plus evaluator corrupts the instructions of 8,493 of its 10,030 variants by appending the perturbation’s parameters (Table 4 ); Flex- π \pi ( Yan et al., 2026a ) noted this issue but substitutes BDDL annotations that paraphrase the training instructions for most variants, so that the language remains perturbed. We therefore also evaluate all open policies with corrected in-distribution instructions (Appendix B ). The corruption affects video-generator-based WAMs most strongly, obscuring their true robustness to several perturbations: with corrected instructions, Fast-WAM gains 19.3 points, LeapBot-WA 8.1, and Cosmos Policy 4.1, whereas image-generator-based WAMs and VLM-based policies change by at most 1.4 points and La-JEPA gains 3.9 to 6.3. With corrected instructions, every La-JEPA size exceeds every re-evaluated policy without embodied pretraining (Table 1 ), and L leads NowWAM by 1.8 points with four times fewer deployed parameters; it also exceeds the embodied-pretrained π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and π \pi -JEPA-WAM (Table 14 ).
blocks.zh: 发行的LIBERO-Plus评价器通过附加扰动参数(表4)来腐蚀其10,030种变体中的8,493种指令;Flex-π\pi(Yan等人,2026a)注意到了这个问题,但替代了BDDL说明,解释大多数变体的训练指示,使语言仍然扰动. 因此,我们还评估所有开放政策以及更正的分配指示(附录B)。 腐败对基于视频生成器的WAM影响最大,将其真正的稳健性掩盖在几处扰动中:经过纠正的指示,快速生成器收益为19.3分,LeapBot-WA收益为8.1分,宇宙政策收益为4.1分,而基于图像生成器的WAM和基于VLM的政策变化最多为1.4分,La-JEPA收益为3.9至6.3分。 在经过修正的指示下,每个La-JEPA的规模都超过每个重新评价的政策,而不包含预先训练(表1),L领导NowWAM比部署的参数少4倍;它也超过已包含的预先训练的 ^ 0.5\pi\0.5}和 ^\pi - JEPA-WAM(表14)。

blocks.en: 5.3 Comparison with Latent World-Action Models
blocks.zh: 5.3 与后期世界行动模式的比较

blocks.en: La-JEPA also outperforms the two closest JEPA-based world-action models on LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0, although both retain pretrained predictors (Table 3 ). LeapBot-WA, which also pretrains on robot data and deploys 10.4B parameters, falls below all three La-JEPA sizes on LIBERO-Plus with both the released and the corrected instructions (Table 14 in Appendix B ). JEPA-WAM, built on a pretrained Qwen2.5 model ( Qwen et al., 2024 ) , is exceeded on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus by all three La-JEPA sizes, S and B deploying fewer parameters. On RoboTwin, JEPA-WAM trains and evaluates on 20 of the 50 tasks, and on these tasks every La-JEPA size, trained on all 50, leads it by more than 15 points in clean and 9 points in randomized scenes. This subset is easier than the full benchmark, since per-task DP3 and ACT policies score about 20 points higher on it in clean scenes (Appendix B ); because it was chosen by JEPA-WAM and applies equally to both methods, we do not consider the comparison biased in our favor. Even when JEPA-WAM’s scores are extrapolated to all 50 tasks using this difficulty gap, every La-JEPA size remains ahead in both regimes. LDA-1B, pretrained on over 30k hours of human and robot data with a 4B vision-language model ( Lyu et al., 2026 ) , remains far below on both benchmarks ( Yan et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: La-JEPA在LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin 2.0上的表现也超过了两个最接近JEPA的世界行动模型,尽管两者都保留了预先训练的预测器(表3). LIBERO-Plus上的LeapBot-WA也预留了机器人数据,并部署了10.4B参数,但该参数低于所有三个La-JEPA的尺寸,同时附有发布和校正的指令(附录B表14)。 JEPA-WAM以经过预先训练的Quen2.5型号(Quen等人,2024年)为基础,在LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上被所有三个LA-JEPA大小,S和B部署的参数都超过了. 在RoboTwin上,JEPA-WAM对50项任务中的20项进行了列车和评审,并且根据这些任务,每个La-JEPA大小,经过全部50项训练,在清洁场景中领先超过15分,随机场景中领先9分. 这个子集比完整的基准更容易,因为每个任务DP3和ACT政策在干净的场景中得分比它高约20分(附录B);因为它是JEPA-WAM所选择的,并同样适用于两种方法,所以我们并不认为比较对我们有利. 即便JEPA-WAM的得分被推算为所有50项任务, LDA-1B在使用4B视觉语言模型(Lyu等人,2026年)的超过30k小时的人类和机器人数据上进行预训(Yan等人,2026年b),在这两个基准上仍然远远低于.。

blocks.en: 5.4 Computational Cost
blocks.zh: 5.4 计算费用

blocks.en: La-JEPA updates 0.10 to 1.14 B parameters during training, far fewer than the video-generator and vision-language-action baselines (2.0 to 7.8 B; Tables 1 and 2 ) while showing lower replan latency at matched or better performance. We time complete policy calls, with ten denoising steps on one consumer GPU (Table 15 , Appendix C ). With optimized (compiled) builds, S and B run two to five times faster than Fast-WAM and Faster-WAM, and S with original-kernel CUDA graphs, which reproduce uncompiled actions bit-for-bit, remains 2.6 × \times faster than optimized Fast-WAM. Compiled builds do not significantly change closed-loop LIBERO success (Appendix C ), and the physical-robot policy runs compiled. Reducing inference to three denoising steps lowers latency further while keeping success within about one point (Appendix E.2 ), consistent with evidence that diffusion policies do not require many denoising steps ( Clémente et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: La-JEPA更新为0.10至1.14 培训期间的B参数远远低于视频生成器和视觉语言行动基线(2.0至7.8 B;表1和表2),同时显示相应或较好性能的延迟度较低。 我们时间完成政策呼吁,对一个消费者GPU采取十项取消提名的步骤(附录C表15)。 在优化(编译)构建后,S和B运行速度比Fast-WAM和Fast-WAM快2到5倍,S运行速度与原内核CUDA图,复制未编译动作位换位,仍然比Fast-WAM运行速度快2.6×\时间. 编译的建筑不会显著改变闭路LIBERO的成功(Appendix C),物理机器人政策运行编译. 根据传播政策不需要许多去诺步骤的证据(Clémente等人,2025年),将推论降低到三个去诺步骤进一步降低了延迟度,同时将成功保持在约1点之内(附录E.2 ).

blocks.zh: 图5:真机器人任务:立方体布置,摘果,推T,和盘操纵.

blocks.en: 5.5 Real-Robot Experiments
blocks.zh: 5.5 真机器人实验

blocks.en: Table 5: Real-robot successes out of 20 and benchmark policy-call latency in ms, not control-loop timing (Appendix C ); LingBot-VA’s is rounded to 10 ms. Position: full dish success with correct utensil placement; Average: mean over the four tasks. LingBot-VA dish: 10 trials. Bold: best.
blocks.zh: 表5:实际机器人成功率在20位中和基准政策调用延迟率在ms中,而非控制启动时间(附录C);LingBot-VA的周期为10ms。 姿势:用正确的餐具布置完全成功; 平均值:在四项任务之上刻意表示。 灵灵 Bot-VA 菜式:10个试验. 粗体:最好.

blocks.en: We train a La-JEPA B policy from scratch, with encoder LoRA but without image augmentation, on demonstrations of four Franka tabletop tasks (Figure 5 ; Appendix D ) and compare it with Fast-WAM, Faster-WAM, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , and LingBot-VA ( Li et al., 2026 ) in Table 5 . We start with a simple cube placement as control, then test on fruit picking which requires lifting a lid, setting it down, and choosing the correct fruit; Push T tests contact-heavy interactions; and our dish task requires placing two plates from a rack onto the table, then a spoon on the gray plate and a fork on the pink plate in one uninterrupted rollout, with interchangeable utensil positions that require distinguishing the utensils.
blocks.zh: 我们从头开始对La-JEPA B政策进行培训,其中编码器为LORA,但不增加图像,用于演示四个Franka桌面任务(图5;附录D),并将其与表5中的Fast-WAM、Fast-WAM、0.5\pi_{0.5}和LingBot-VA(Li等人,2026年)进行比较。 我们首先用一个简单的立方体放置作为控制,然后测试采果,这需要抬起一个盖子,将其放下,并选择正确的果实; 推推T测试接触-重力相互作用; 我们的菜肴任务需要将两个板子从一个架子上放到桌子上,然后用一个勺子放在灰色板子上,用一个叉子放在粉红色板子上,在一次不间断的展开中,有可互换的餐具位置,需要区分餐具。

blocks.en: La-JEPA achieves the highest average success among policies without embodied pretraining and is comparable to the embodied-pretrained π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , although its policy transformer is trained only on the target demonstrations. It is the most successful policy on Push T, whereas π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} leads on the long-horizon dish task. On successful trials, La-JEPA also completes every task faster than the other policies without embodied pretraining (Appendix D ), and faster than π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} on fruit picking and Push T, though slower on the dish task. LingBot-VA rarely succeeds on Push T and dish manipulation and is several times slower than every other policy. LingBot-VA’s low success may reflect a need for more real-robot finetuning than the shared budget allowed (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: La-JEPA在政策中取得了最高的平均成功,没有包含预先培训,并且与已包含的预先培训的 ^ 0.5\pi_{0.5}相当,尽管其政策变迁器只接受目标示范的培训。 这是Push T最成功的政策, 在成功的试验中,La-JEPA也比其他政策更快地完成每一项任务,没有包含预先训练(附录D),在摘果和推倒T方面比Q 0.5\pi\0.5}快,尽管在菜肴任务上速度较慢。 灵灵 Bot-VA在Push T和菜肴操纵上很少成功,并且比其他政策慢了好几倍. 灵灵 Bot-VA的低成功率可能反映出比共享预算(附录D)更需要真正的机器人微调.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: We aim to show the potential of compact world-action policies rather than to optimize them exhaustively: beyond the targeted design studies, we did not systematically search learning rates, weight decay, dropout rates, LoRA configurations, or the relative capacity of the World and Action DiTs. This lack of scale-specific tuning, together with limited target data, may contribute to the non-monotonic RoboTwin scaling; our experiments do not isolate these effects. We also recognize that many high-performing baselines have external supervision objectives and robot-specific architectures that we do not: while this work does outline the performance of a policy with a simple setup, we cannot be certain that our improvements would stack with other work’s policy upgrades.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是展示紧凑的世界行动政策的潜力,而不是详尽地优化这些政策:除了目标明确的设计研究之外,我们没有系统地搜索学习率、体重衰减率、辍学率、LORA配置或世界和行动DiTs的相对能力。 这种缺乏针对规模的调制,加上目标数据有限,可能助长非模态的RoboTwin调制;我们的实验并不孤立这些效果. 我们还认识到,许多高性能的基线都有外部监督目标和机器人特有的架构,我们并不认为:虽然这项工作确实概述了一个简单设置的政策的执行情况,但我们不能确定,我们的改进会与其他工作的政策升级叠加起来。

blocks.en: Our policies learn from target demonstrations alone, so how La-JEPA scales with embodied pretraining remains open. Adapting the policy and its visual representation across embodiments and environments would also test whether data, rather than capacity, limits the larger models. We consider this the principal future direction of research that should come out of this paper. La-JEPA remains below the strongest embodied-pretrained methods on randomized RoboTwin scenes, and its real-robot average, although comparable to that of π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , comes from four tasks on one robot setup and does not establish parity across broader manipulation demands. The richer supervision, synthetic data, and additional objectives used by some stronger baselines are natural extensions of La-JEPA that we have not tested.
blocks.zh: 我们的政策仅从目标示范中学习,因此《拉-JEPA》中包含的预训规模如何保持开放。 调整政策及其在各种表现和环境上的视觉表现,也将检验数据而不是能力是否限制了更大的模型。 我们认为,这是本文应提出的主要研究方向。 La-JEPA在随机化的RoboTwin场景上仍然低于最强的内含预训方法,其实际机器人平均率虽然可以与π0.5\pi_{0.5}相比,但是来自一个机器人设置上的四项任务,并没有在更广泛的操纵需求中确立对等. 更丰富的监督、综合数据和一些更强有力的基线使用的其他目标,是我们尚未测试的La-JEPA的自然延伸。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We asked whether world-action policies must inherit the architecture of a generative backbone, and whether a compact transformer trained from scratch can compete with those that do. Trained in a pretrained JEPA feature space, La-JEPA reaches the strongest RoboTwin 2.0 clean and randomized results among policies without embodied pretraining, and the strongest LIBERO-Plus results once the benchmark’s corrupted instructions are corrected, while running up to 5 × \times faster than Fast-WAM. On four physical tasks, La-JEPA’s average success is comparable to that of the embodied-pretrained π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} . Through our study, we empirically validate the benefits of the V-JEPA latent space for control tasks, provide some guidance on the benefits of different robustness design improvements and find that heavy generative models are not a requirement for high-performing learned policies.
blocks.zh: 我们问,世界行动政策是否必须继承基因骨干结构,从零开始训练的紧凑变压器是否能够与有这种结构的变压器竞争。 La-JEPA在经过预先训练的JEPA的特色空间中,在没有包含预训内容的政策中取得了最强的RoboTwin 2.0 干净和随机的结果,而最强的LIBERO-Plus则在基准被破坏的指示被纠正后取得结果,同时运行速度比Fast-WAM快达5××××时。 La-JEPA在四项实际任务上的平均成功率, 通过我们的研究,我们从经验上验证了V-JEPA潜在的控制任务空间的好处,就不同强性设计改进的好处提供了一些指导,并发现重基因模型并不是高性能的学习政策的要求。

blocks.en: AI Use Statement
blocks.zh: AI 使用语句

blocks.en: In this work, we used generative AI tools to implement methods, including the optimization of the training and dataloading pipeline which was particularly heavy, evaluation, and data-preprocessing code; to reformat datasets into precomputed feature stores (always through verifiable scripts); and to help design the infrastructure that enabled the interpretation of our large amount of results. We did not use generative AI tools to generate synthetic data, develop theoretical models, formulate or prove mathematical claims, or translate text; these uses are not applicable to this work. Additionally, we used generative AI tools to edit parts of the paper, to write the code that generates figures and tables from recorded results, to search for and summarize related literature, and to format references. We have reviewed all AI-assisted work: code was tested and validated against recorded outputs, reported numbers were traced to their evaluation records, figures and tables are generated by code from the underlying data directly, never by the AI tool itself, and references were checked against their arXiv entries. We take responsibility for the final content of this work, including text, claims, or artifacts produced with the aid of generative AI.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们使用基因AI工具来实施方法,包括优化特别繁重的培训和数据加载管道、评价和数据预处理代码;将数据集重构为预先计算过的功能库(总是通过可核查的脚本);并帮助设计能够解释我们大量结果的基础设施。 我们没有使用基因AI工具生成合成数据,开发理论模型,提出或证明数学主张,或翻译文字;这些用途不适用于这项工作. 此外,我们使用基因AI工具编辑论文的部分内容,编写从记录结果中生成数字和表格的代码,搜索和总结相关文献,以及格式引用. 我们审查了所有AI辅助工作:对照记录的产出测试和验证了代码,报告的数字追踪到其评价记录,数字和表格直接由基础数据生成代码,从未由AI工具本身生成,参考文献对照其arXiv条目进行核对。 我们负责这项工作的最后内容,包括文字、权利主张或由大赦国际协助制作的文物。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work uses public simulation benchmarks and robot demonstrations collected by the authors through teleoperation; it involves no human-subject studies and releases no new dataset. We do not foresee harms specific to this work beyond those of robot learning in general.

blocks.en: All design studies use the original data and evaluation pipelines (Appendix B ), so each comparison is made within that pipeline. All design-study transformers are trained from scratch and evaluated with EMA weights, including the corresponding EMA encoder weights for policies with encoder LoRA. Studies use the small (S) policy unless stated otherwise, and each result comes from a single training run, except for the three-seed LIBERO-Plus comparison of predictive supervision. Several studies train on a subset of the training demonstrations, nominally 95%, which on LIBERO retains 1,663 of the 1,743 episodes; we call it the 95% split and state the training data of each comparison below. LIBERO evaluations cover 2,000 episodes with a 700-step budget in every suite unless stated otherwise, and LIBERO-Plus evaluations all 10,030 episodes with the upstream suite-specific step limits; both redraw action noise at every replan. RoboTwin evaluation budgets are listed per block in Table 6 ; the 1,000-episode budgets are ablation evaluations, smaller than the 5,000-episode headline protocol (Appendix B ).

blocks.en: These studies determine whether the policy should predict future features, in which representation, and how motion and spatial resolution enter the tokens (Section 4.1 ).

blocks.en: Joint action and future-feature prediction improves LIBERO-Plus success over action-only training for each of three training seeds, raising mean success from 74.35% to 76.47%, a gain of 2.12 points (Table 7 ). Figure 3 A shows this mean gain; its in-distribution bar uses the seed-42 pair at 150k updates, evaluated on 2,000 LIBERO episodes. Both objectives train on all 1,743 LIBERO episodes of the original pipeline for 150,000 updates with image augmentation and encoder LoRA, whereas the headline policies use the revised pipeline (Appendix B ), so these controls are not directly comparable to Table 1 . The action-only control omits future-feature supervision and computation while preserving the action pathway. For each objective and training seed, we select the checkpoint with the highest LIBERO success from the 30k, 60k, 90k, 120k, and 150k grid and evaluate it on all 10,030 LIBERO-Plus episodes with EMA weights, action-noise scale 1 redrawn at every replan, ten denoising steps, and ten-action execution chunks. Selection picks the same step for both objectives within each seed. Paired tests use identical task and evaluation-seed episodes for the two objectives.

Selection on the 1,000-episode clean grid picks 150k for joint training and 120k for action-only training, with ties broken toward the later step.

blocks.en: Block B compares frozen, static V-JEPA 2.1 features with Wan2.2 VAE latents at 150k updates, with action and future-feature prediction on the 95% split. Within each benchmark, feature dimensions, normalization, and input and output projections remain representation-specific, so the comparison concerns the two representation systems rather than their pretraining objectives in isolation. On RoboTwin, both policies use 384-dimensional, 12-layer transformers with patch grouping for observations and future targets and are evaluated on 5,000-episode clean and randomized manifests with 24-action execution chunks. On LIBERO, both use the 768-dimensional, 12-layer B transformer with 2 × 2\times spatial mean pooling and 10-action execution chunks; LIBERO evaluation instead uses a 600-step budget per suite and 30 settling steps, and LIBERO-Plus evaluation uses action-noise scale 1. On LIBERO-Plus, V-JEPA succeeds in 5,773 episodes and Wan2.2 in 5,173. All evaluations use EMA weights, a single observation context, and 10 denoising steps.
blocks.zh: B块将冷冻,静态V-JEPA2.1特性与在150k更新时的Wan2.2 VAE潜伏进行对比,对95%的分裂进行动作和未来地貌预测. 在每个基准内,特征层面、正常化、投入和产出预测仍然是针对代表性的,因此比较涉及两个代表性系统,而不是孤立地进行预先训练的目标。 在RoboTwin上,两种政策都使用384维的12层变压器,并附有补丁分组,用于观测和未来的目标,并用5 000集的清洁和随机运单进行评估,其中包含24个动作执行块。 在LIBERO上,两者均使用768维,12层B型变压器,带2×2×时的空间平均集合和10个动作执行块;LIBERO评价则使用每套600步预算和30个结算步骤,LIBERO-Plus评价则使用动作噪声尺度. 1. 在LIBERO-Plus上,V-JEPA成功5,773集,Wan2.2成功5,173集. 所有评价都使用EMA权重,单一的观测上下文,以及10个调试步骤.

blocks.en: Two further RoboTwin comparisons pool the future targets, each evaluated on 5,000 episodes per regime (clean only for the first). With full-data, static-feature training and patch-grouped observations, V-JEPA and Wan2.2 achieve 61.50% and 61.44% clean success at 150k. In the second, with 768-dimensional transformers, Wan2.2 leads on clean success (63.90% versus 61.12%), whereas V-JEPA leads on randomized success (15.00% versus 1.28%). V-JEPA’s advantage therefore holds in randomized scenes but not consistently in clean ones.
blocks.zh: 另外两个RoboTwin比较汇集了未来的目标,每个系统每集评估5 000次(仅清理第一个系统)。 V-JEPA和Wan2.2通过全数据、静态环境培训和补丁群观测,在150k上实现了61.50%和61.44%的清洁成功。 在第二部中,Wan2.2以768维变压器领先于清洁成功(63.90%对61.12%),而V-JEPA则领先于随机成功(15.0%对1.28%). 因此,V-JEPA的优势存在于随机的场景中,但在干净的场景中并不一贯。

blocks.en: Block C compares three frozen-encoder policies with patch grouping, trained on the 95% split, that differ only in the encoding: static, tube, or tube-motion. Each regime uses 1,000 episodes on the same scenes, and randomized success is read at the checkpoint selected on clean episodes: 150k for static and tube-motion, and 120k for tube.
blocks.zh: 块 C将3个冷冻编码器政策与修补组进行对比,经过95%的拆分法培训,这只在编码上有所不同:静态,管子,或管动. 每个政权在同一场景上使用1000集,在清场时选择的检查点会随机读取成功:静态和管动为150k,管动为120k.

blocks.en: On RoboTwin, grouping neighboring features into one token by concatenation (patch grouping) instead of averaging them (mean pooling) changes clean success by + 0.3 +0.3 points and raises randomized success by 4.1 points. Both policies apply the reduction to two-frame observations and to motion-based future targets and are compared at 150k updates; each clean and randomized evaluation uses 1,000 episodes, 32 samples per pixel, rendering depth 8, OIDN denoising, and action noise fixed within each episode. The pooling policy uses the full training set and the patch-grouping policy the 95% split, and their target normalization and projections also differ, so the comparison does not isolate the reduction operator. By contrast, on LIBERO, in a one-variable comparison between stored-feature S policies with tube-motion encoding at 150k updates, evaluated identically on 2,000 episodes, mean pooling reaches 94.05% against 89.35% for patch grouping. The final recipe uses patch grouping on RoboTwin, reducing the head camera 2 × 2\times and the wrist cameras 4 × 4\times , and 2 × 2\times mean pooling on LIBERO (Appendix B ). Appendix E.3 reports a related sweep that pools only the future targets.
blocks.zh: 在RoboTwin上,将邻居的特征通过凝聚(patch group)组合成一个符号,而不是平均它们(平均集合)以+0.3+0.3分改变干净成功,以4.1分提升随机成功. 这两项政策都将减少应用于双帧观测和基于运动的未来目标,并以150k的更新进行对比;每一次清洁和随机评估使用1000集,每像素32个样本,渲染深度8,OIDN去诺音,在每个集内固定动作噪声. 集合政策使用完整的训练集和补丁分组政策95%拆分,它们的目标正常化和预测也有所不同,因此比较并不孤立减少操作者. 相比之下,在LIBERO上,在150k更新时对存储特性S政策与管动编码进行单变量比较时,对2000集进行相同的评价,这意味着集合率达到94.05%,对补丁分组为89.35%。 最后的食谱在RoboTwin上使用补丁分组,减少头摄像头2×2\时和腕摄像头4×4\时,2×2\时表示集合在LIBERO上(附录B). 附录E.3报告了仅汇集未来目标的相关扫荡情况。

blocks.en: These studies target robustness to changes in the observations through camera and proprioception dropout, image augmentation, and encoder adaptation (Section 4.2 ). All LIBERO variants in blocks D and F train on the 95% split and are selected on LIBERO success: stored-feature policies with a frozen encoder at 90k updates, and online-encoder variants at 120k.
blocks.zh: 这些研究的目标是通过摄像头和自行消减、图像增强和编码器的适应,实现观测变化的稳健性(第4.2节)。 所有LIBERO变体在95%拆分的D区块和F区块列车中,在LIBERO成功时被选中: 存储特性政策,冷冻编码器更新90k,在线编码器变体更新120k.

blocks.en: The LIBERO row of block D compares either-camera with wrist-only dropout in stored-feature policies. Table 8 reports the effect of this change, and of the adaptation variants below, on the camera-viewpoint and sensor-noise categories of LIBERO-Plus.

blocks.en: The RoboTwin row of block D compares two frozen-encoder, static-feature policies at 150k updates that differ only in wrist-camera dropout with probability 0.1. blocks.en: On LIBERO, block F compares encoder LoRA, image augmentation, and both combined against the plain, either-camera-dropout policy of block D; the variants run the encoder online and are selected at 120k updates, whereas the plain reference uses stored features and is selected at 90k. On RoboTwin, the frozen-encoder policy without augmentation is compared with the augmentation-and-LoRA policy trained with the final augmentation pipeline, both at 150k updates and evaluated on 5,000 episodes per regime; the plain policy uses 2,400 of the 2,500 demonstrations and the augmentation-and-LoRA policy all 2,500, and the evaluation implementations also differ. Because the policies also differ in training duration on LIBERO and in training data on RoboTwin, block F measures recipe-level gains rather than isolated effects.

blocks.en: Table 10 lists the final augmentation recipe. After the gate that leaves a window unmodified, transformation gates are independent, and parameters are shared across frames. Only observations are augmented; future targets are computed from unmodified frames by the frozen encoder.

blocks.en: Before training, we encode every demonstration once with the frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder and store the resulting features. Stored-feature policies, used in most design studies, read both observations and future targets from these stores and never run the encoder during training. Encoder LoRA and image augmentation require encoding the observations at every training step, so the final policies encode their observation clips online but still read their future targets from the stores. Encoding the targets online as well would dominate the encoder cost of each step, since each camera’s targets span 16 frames, eight times as many encoder tokens as its two-frame observation clip. Targets from the adapting encoder also do not improve success (Appendix E.1 ), so the targets remain those of the frozen encoder.
blocks.zh: 在训练前,我们用冷冻的V-JEPA 2.1编码器编码每一次演示,并存储由此产生的特性. 在大多数设计研究中使用的存储特性政策,既读取这些商店的观测结果,又读取未来的目标,在训练期间从未运行过编码器. Encoder LoRA和图像增强要求在每个训练步骤上对观测进行编码,因此最终政策将他们的观测剪辑在线编码,但仍从商店读取他们的未来目标. 将目标在线编码也会主导每个步骤的编码器成本,因为每个相机的目标跨16帧,是其双帧观测片段的8倍。 适应编码器的目标也并不能改善成功(Appendix E.1 ),因此目标仍然是冷冻编码器的目标.

blocks.en: The features are then reduced spatially before entering the World DiT. Mean pooling, the simplest reduction, averages each 2 × 2 2\times 2 neighborhood of a feature grid into one token. Because it can be applied once when the features are precomputed, it shrinks the stored features fourfold. Most of our development therefore used pre-pooled stores, which are much smaller and far easier to load during training than full-resolution V-JEPA features. Patch grouping instead concatenates neighboring features into one wider token, reducing the number of tokens without discarding any feature values, but the stored features keep their full size. Mean pooling suffices on LIBERO, whereas on RoboTwin the detail it averages away matters: patch grouping raises randomized success by 4.1 points (Appendix A.1 ), so the final RoboTwin recipe uses patch grouping.
blocks.zh: 之后在进入世界DiT之前,这些特征在空间上被缩小. 平均集合,最简单的减少,平均每2×2 2\次2个特征网格的邻里变成一个符号. 因为它在特性被预先计算时可以被应用一次,它缩小了存储的特性四倍. 因此,我们的大多数开发都使用了预集商店,这些商店比全分辨率的V-JEPA功能要小得多,在培训期间更容易装载。 补丁分组将邻居的特性组合成一个更宽的符号,在不丢弃任何特性值的情况下减少符数,但存储的特性保持其全尺寸. 平均集合在LIBERO上就足够了,而在RoboTwin上,它平均去掉细节:补丁分组以4.1分(Appendix A.1 )提升随机成功,所以最终的RoboTwin配方使用补丁分组.

blocks.en: On LIBERO, all three sizes train on all 1,777 demonstrations retained by the revised pipeline (Appendix B ) for 150,000 updates, and we report the final checkpoints’ performances averaged over three training seeds; L additionally uses full-depth LoRA. The final RoboTwin S, B, and L policies train on the 2,438 clean demonstrations retained by the revised pipeline (Appendix B ) with three training seeds each. For each seed, the checkpoint is selected among 90k, 120k, and 150k updates on a 1,000-episode clean grid disjoint from the evaluation episodes, which picks 150k for every seed except one L seed (120k); the selected policies are evaluated on 5,000 episodes per condition with action noise redrawn at every replan, and we report the mean over seeds.
blocks.zh: 在LIBERO,所有3个大小的示威都用经过修改的管道(附录B)保留下来的1,777个示威进行训练,进行15万次更新,我们报告,最后检查站的性能平均在3个训练种子上;L还使用了全深度的LORA。 最终的RoboTwin S,B,L政策列车在经过修改的管道(附录B)保留下来的2,438个清洁演示上进行,每组3个训练种子. 对每个种子,检查点从90k,120k中选择,对1000集的清洁网格与评价片断的150k更新,每个种子除一个L种子(120k)外选取150k;对选定的政策每情况评价5000集,每次重新设计时都会重新绘制动作噪声,我们报告种子的平均值。

blocks.en: LIBERO scores are success rates over the four standard suites. LIBERO-Plus scores are success rates over all 10,030 evaluation episodes of the seven perturbation categories, including background textures, weighting every episode rather than every category equally. Literature aggregates are recomputed from reported per-category rates when needed. La-JEPA’s headline LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus evaluations use MuJoCo 3.3.2 and the upstream suite-specific step limits (220, 280, 300, and 520 steps, after 10 settling steps). The design studies, evaluation-setting sweeps, and compiled-build validation keep a flat budget in every suite, 700 steps except for the LIBERO pair of block B (600 steps after 30 settling steps; Appendix A.1 ), so each comparison is made within one protocol. RoboTwin policies are trained on clean demonstrations and evaluated in clean and randomized scenes, and the mean of the two regimes is the leaderboard aggregate. La-JEPA’s RoboTwin policies are conditioned on each episode’s own RoboTwin instruction in both training and evaluation. JEPA-WAM reports 20 RoboTwin tasks, so Table 3 restricts our evaluations to the same tasks, using 2,000 episodes per condition and training seed. JEPA-WAM trains only on these 20 tasks, whereas our policies train on all 50. The subset is easier than the full benchmark: per-task DP3 and ACT policies reach 73.9% and 51.8% clean success on it ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , against 55.2% and 29.7% over all 50 tasks ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . Projected to all 50 tasks, JEPA-WAM’s success is estimated at 65.5% clean and 25.0% randomized (see the full-suite estimate below), below every La-JEPA size in Table 2 . Methods pretrained on robot trajectories beyond the target demonstrations are outside the main comparison and are explicitly identified in the latent world-action model comparison, the leaderboard figure, and the physical-robot comparison.
blocks.zh: LIBERO的分数是四个标准套房的成功率. blocks.en: LIBERO: 1. Simulator version: Demonstrations are rendered and all policies are evaluated with MuJoCo 3.3.2, the version used by the compared baselines; under newer releases such as 3.9.0, the bowl in the task “pick up the black bowl on the ramekin” is unseated at reset. 2. Demonstration filtering: Each demonstration’s recorded actions are replayed from its recorded initial state, and only demonstrations that end in task success are kept: 1,777 of the 2,000. 3. Proprioception alignment: Each frame is paired with the proprioceptive state at its own time step, as at evaluation. 4. Normalization: States and actions use per-channel 1st/99th-percentile scaling to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] , as in OpenVLA-OFT ( Kim et al., 2025 ) and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ) . 5. End-of-episode windows: Training windows extend to the end of each demonstration, and missing future targets are masked from the loss. 6. Training schedule: All sizes train on all retained demonstrations for 150,000 updates, and we report the final checkpoint averaged over the three seeds. 7. Evaluation protocol: Each episode takes 10 settling steps before the policy acts and is scored at the upstream per-suite step limits (220, 280, 300, and 520 steps). Table 11 compares these policies with the original-pipeline ones, which were evaluated under MuJoCo 3.9.0.

blocks.en: RoboTwin 2.0: 1. Normalization: States and actions use the same per-channel percentile scaling as on LIBERO, clamped to ± 5 \pm 5 , with gripper commands mapped from [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] . 2. Joint-angle wrapping: In 62 of the 2,500 clean demonstrations, spread over 21 of the 50 tasks, the planned joint path crosses ± π \pm\pi , where the wrap-around makes the joint trajectory discontinuous. We exclude these demonstrations and train on the remaining 2,438 (538,662 frames, at least 41 per task). 3. End-of-episode windows: Training windows extend to the end of each episode; padded steps and padded future-target rows are masked from the loss, as on LIBERO. 4. Instructions: Each episode is conditioned on its own official RoboTwin instruction. 5. Task isolation: Each task is evaluated in its own simulator process. In dump_bin_bigbin and put_bottles_dustbin , the upstream scene setup shifts the clutter region at every reset, so that it drifts across episodes; we keep this upstream behavior for comparability with leaderboard results, and the isolation prevents it from affecting other tasks, all of which pass a per-reset scene check. Table 12 compares these policies with the original-pipeline ones: clean success rises by 5 to 8 points at every size, randomized success falls by 5 to 9 points, and the mean of the two regimes changes by at most one point.

blocks.en: Table 13 compares the instruction a policy receives under four sources. The LIBERO training demonstrations store each task’s instruction in their metadata, identical to the instruction that standard LIBERO evaluation derives from the task’s file name. The released LIBERO-Plus evaluator derives the instruction from the variant’s file name instead, so every non-language variant receives the training instruction followed by the perturbation’s parameters. Flex- π \pi ( Yan et al., 2026a ) replaces it with the :language annotation of the variant’s BDDL file, falling back to the base task’s file for camera, robot-initial-state, and sensor-noise variants. These annotations are written independently of the training instructions: across the 8,493 non-language variants, only 2,351 match the training instruction exactly and 3,148 up to capitalization, so most variants still receive a paraphrase that the policy never saw during training. Our corrected text gives every non-language variant its base task’s training instruction verbatim. For the 1,537 language variants, whose paraphrases are the intended perturbation, the released and corrected texts are identical, and Flex- π \pi ’s annotations contain the same words but differ in capitalization for 1,209 of them. All re-evaluations share one protocol; NowWAM, Fast-WAM, and ImageWAM, whose released evaluations use longer step limits, are scored at the upstream per-suite limits like every other policy. Table 14 reports both evaluations. Because the corruption affects policies to different degrees, released-instruction scores partly rank policies by their sensitivity to corrupted text rather than by their robustness to the intended perturbation: correcting the instructions reverses the order of NowWAM and La-JEPA B and L, and of Cosmos Policy and La-JEPA S. With corrected instructions, S is on par with NowWAM, and L’s 1.8-point lead exceeds both its seed-to-seed standard deviation (0.3 points) and the binomial standard error of a single 10,030-episode evaluation (about 0.35 points).

blocks.en: Tables 15 and 5 time complete benchmark policy calls, not executed actions or control-loop cycles. Each timed call includes fresh instruction tokenization and encoding, input preparation, transfer, and host-side action output; loading, compilation, simulation, and transport are excluded. Text and vision encoders run on parallel streams where supported. Eager execution is uncompiled; original-kernel CUDA graphs reduce launch overhead without changing kernels; optimized builds also compile the computation. The head-to-head WAM rows use ten denoising steps and 32 predicted actions, whereas the three-step rows and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} (official JAX JIT, ten steps, native ten-action horizon) are separate operating points. Each method keeps its native inputs: La-JEPA uses two 256 × 256 256\times 256 cameras with two adjacent frames and FLAN-T5-large, timed in FP32 (our success evaluations use FP16), whereas in our setup Fast-WAM and Faster-WAM use two 224 × 224 224\times 224 single-frame cameras and BF16 UMT5-XXL ( Chung et al., 2023 ) . Action noise is pre-drawn and copied inside the timed call for La-JEPA, and drawn on the CPU inside the call for Fast-WAM. LingBot-VA is timed on the same device under the same protocol with its native implementation and appears, rounded to 10 ms, only in Table 5 .
blocks.zh: 表15和5 完整的基准政策呼吁,没有执行行动或控制周期。 每次定时调用包括新指令符号化和编码,输入准备,传输,以及主机侧动作输出;加载,编译,模拟,运输被排除在外. 文本和视觉编码器运行在支持的平行流上. eager执行不编译;原内核CUDA图在不改变内核的情况下减少发射管理费;优化的构建也编译了计算. 头对头的WAM行使用十个调音步骤和32个预言动作,而三步行和  0.5\pi_{0.5}(官方JAX JIT,十步,本土十动作视野)则是独立的操作点. 每种方法都保留其本地输入: La-JEPA使用两台256×256256\times 256相机,两台相机相机相机相机相机和FLAN-T5型大相机相机,在FP32中定时(我们的成功评价使用FP16),而在我们的设置中,Fast-WAM和Frail-WAM则使用两台224×224/224\times 单帧相机和BF16 UMT5-XXL(Chung等人,2023年). 动作噪声在预画中被复制在定时调用La-JEPA,并在调用Fast-WAM的调用中抽取CPU. 灵灵 Bot-VA在同一个协议下的同一装置上定时,并原地执行,只出现在表5中,四舍五入至10毫秒。

blocks.en: For La-JEPA, original-kernel CUDA graphs reproduce eager actions bit-for-bit across 36 replays per model on 12 inputs that vary observations, instructions, and noise. blocks.en: Using the original-pipeline checkpoints (Appendix B ), we evaluate the exact timed builds on 2,000 LIBERO episodes with a 700-step budget in every suite (Appendix B ), with action noise of scale 1 redrawn at every replan, and compare each with uncompiled execution of the same checkpoint using paired McNemar tests. Compiled ten-step builds reach 95.20%, 97.05%, and 96.25% for S, B, and L, against 94.30%, 97.35%, and 96.50% uncompiled ( p = 0.15 p=0.15 , 0.59 0.59 , and 0.69 0.69 ). blocks.en: Table 16 lists the components behind the size columns. Trainable counts the weights updated on target demonstrations, including LoRA adapters. Deployed counts the policy and encoder parameter inventory, including frozen visual and language encoders; it is a size measure, not a measurement of memory use or operations per action. Deployed counts merge LoRA adapters into the encoder weights, adding no parameters, and count shared encoders once across cameras. Baseline counts use measured checkpoints or published inventories; where encoder-only counts are unavailable, we count full tokenizer inventories, including unused decoder weights, which conservatively overestimates executed parameters. Transformer initialization refers to the trained world-action predictor or VLA backbone: video or image generation, vision-language pretraining, or random initialization.

Our main hypothesis for LingBot-VA’s low Push T and dish success is that it requires substantially more real-robot finetuning than the other policies; independently of success, its completion times, three to eleven times longer than those of the other policies, make it impractical for closed-loop control on this platform. Its dish entry comes from its single successful trial.

blocks.en: E.1 Adapting Future Targets
blocks.zh: E.1 调整未来目标

blocks.en: On LIBERO with L, we replace the frozen future targets with targets from an EMA of the adapting encoder, keeping the clips, observation processing, and normalization statistics of the frozen-target policy and passing no gradients through the target path. The adapted-target policy, selected at 90k updates, achieves 81.65% on LIBERO-Plus, against 82.26% for the frozen-target policy at 120k, both trained with the original pipeline (Appendix B ) and at action-noise scale 1. Adapted targets do not improve success (paired McNemar p = 0.096 p=0.096 ), so the final recipe retains frozen targets.
blocks.zh: 在LIBERO上,我们用一个适应编码器的EMA的目标来取代被冻结的未来目标,保留被冻结目标政策的剪辑、观察处理和正常化统计,并且不经过目标路径。 在90k更新中选择的经调整的目标政策,在LIBERO-Plus上达到81.65%,而在120k的冻结目标政策上达到82.26%,两者都经过原始管道(附录B)的培训,并达到行动噪音规模 一、导 言 调整后的目标并不能改善成功(paired McNemar p = 0.096 p = 0.096),因此最终食谱保留了冻结的目标.

blocks.en: E.2 Evaluation Settings
blocks.zh: E.2 评价设置

blocks.en: At the 120k checkpoints of the original-pipeline policies (Appendix B ), we vary the execution chunk length, the number of denoising steps, and the action-noise scale for L and B, and test three-step inference for S (Table 19 ); the reference executes ten actions per replan with ten denoising steps and noise scale 1, and LIBERO runs use a 700-step budget in every suite (Appendix B ). Executing only five actions reduces LIBERO-Plus success by 3.29 points for L and 3.45 for B, whereas the number of denoising steps matters less: with three steps, B and L stay within one point of their ten-step references on both benchmarks, and S obtains 94.50% against 94.30% on LIBERO ( p = 0.81 p=0.81 , paired McNemar). Three-step calls take 23 ms for B and 39 ms for L with original-kernel CUDA graphs (Table 15 ), an operating point separate from the ten-step latency comparison. No tested noise scale gives a statistically supported aggregate improvement in the paired comparisons; the original L policy reaches 82.26% at the default scale 1 (Appendix B ), and the best single scale, 0.5, reaches 82.50%.
blocks.zh: 在原管线政策120k的检查站(附录B),我们修改了执行块长度、去诺步骤的数目和L和B的行动噪声尺度,并测试了S的三步推论(表19);参照点每重新规划10个行动,10个去诺步骤和1号噪声尺度,LIBERO在每个套间使用700步预算(附录B)。 执行5项行动,LIBERO-Plus成功率分别降低3.29分和3.45分,而解密步骤的数量则少一些:有三个步骤,B和L在两个基准上都停留在它们十步参考的1点之内,S在LIBERO上获得94.50%,而94.30%(p=0.81 p=0.81,配对为McNemar). 三步调用用原内核CUDA图(表15)为B调用23ms,L调用39ms,这是与十步间隔比较分开的操作点. 没有经过测试的噪声尺度给出了统计支持的对称比较的汇总改进;原始的L政策在默认的1级(附录B)中达到82.26%,最佳的单级(0.5)达到82.50%.

blocks.en: E.3 Future-Only Pooling
blocks.zh: E.3 仅未来集合

blocks.en: Complementing the token-reduction comparison (Appendix A.1 ), we keep patch-grouped observations and mean-pool only the future targets (Table 20 ). In-distribution success stays near 61–62%, whereas out-of-distribution success is non-monotonic in pooling granularity. Because the settings also differ in positional geometry, target normalization, camera weighting, and checkpoint step, these scores describe the tested recipes rather than an isolated effect of target resolution. The policies are small, frozen-encoder, static-feature policies trained on the 95% split. Observations keep patch grouping with spatial factors [ 2 , 4 , 4 ] [2,4,4] for the head, left-wrist, and right-wrist cameras, and the future targets are pooled by [ 2 , 4 , 4 ] [2,4,4] , [ 4 , 8 , 8 ] [4,8,8] , or global averaging, giving [ 80 , 20 , 20 ] [80,20,20] , [ 20 , 6 , 6 ] [20,6,6] , or [ 1 , 1 , 1 ] [1,1,1] spatial tokens per temporal position. The first setting has the patch-grouped reference’s token count but averages rather than concatenates features. The rows report 150k, 60k, and 90k checkpoints, each evaluated in both regimes on 5,000 episodes, under an evaluation implementation that differs from the other studies.
blocks.zh: 作为减少符号比较的补充(附录A.1),我们保留了补丁分组观测,并且只将平均值集合到未来的目标(表20)。 分配中的成功率保持在61-62%左右,而分配外的成功率在组合颗粒性方面是非莫属的。 由于设置在位置几何,目标正常化,相机权重,以及检查台阶上也有所不同,这些分数描述了测试过的食谱,而不是目标解析的孤立效果. 这些政策是小的、冷冻的、静态的政策,对95%的拆分进行了培训。 观测保持有空间因子[2,4,4] [2,4,4]的补丁组合,用于头部,左手,右手相机,未来目标由[2,4,4],[4,4,4],[4,8],[4,8],或全球平均,给出[80,20,20],[80,20,20],[20,20],[20,6],[20,6],或[1,1,1,1],每个时位的空间标志. 第一个设置有补丁类参考物的符号计数,但平均值而非调和特性。 该行报告150k、60k和90k检查站,在两个政权中,每个检查站都进行了5 000次评估,评价的执行情况不同于其他研究。

blocks.en: E.4 Representation Diagnostics
blocks.zh: E.4 代表性诊断

blocks.en: Table 21 analyzes frozen-encoder RoboTwin policies trained with and without future prediction at 150k updates, separate from the policies in Figure 3 A. Centered RankMe ( Garrido et al., 2022 ) uses 2,000 sampled, mean-pooled final-layer value features, and a cosine 5-nearest-neighbor action readout reports R 2 R^{2} over normalized action chunks. Features span 100 episodes held out from policy training, with an episode-disjoint 70/30 split for fitting and testing the readout and with language and proprioceptive conditioning retained. Future prediction raises effective rank together with clean success under the 1,000-episode protocol, but lowers action-readout R 2 R^{2} , so nearest-neighbor action decodability does not explain the difference in control performance.
blocks.zh: 表21分析了在150k更新时接受过和没有未来预测的冷冻编码机RoboTwin政策,与图3 A. Centered RankMe(Garrido等人,2022年)中的政策分开,使用了2 000个抽样、平均集合的终层值特征,以及一个Cosine 5-近邻行动读取报告R 2 RQQX2),超过了正常化行动块。 从政策培训中抽出100集,分集70/30,用于安装和测试读出,并保留语言和自带条件。 未来的预测随着1000集协议下的清洁成功而提高了有效的排名,但降低了动作读取R 2 R^{2},因此最近的邻域动作解码性无法解释控制性能的差异.
